commands: if [ ! -b "$DEVICE" ]; then NVME=$(lsblk -ndo NAME,TYPE | awk '/disk/ {print $1}' | grep -v xvda | head -n1); if [ -n "$NVME" ]; then DEVICE="/dev/$NVME"; fi; fi
if [ ! -b "$DEVICE" ]; then lsblk -o NAME,KNAME,TYPE,SIZE,MOUNTPOINT; exit 1; fi
if ! sudo file -s $DEVICE | grep -q filesystem; then sudo mkfs -t ext4 $DEVICE; fi
if [ -d /var/lib/jenkins ] && [ "$(ls -A /var/lib/jenkins)" ]; then sudo rsync -aHx /var/lib/jenkins/ /mnt/jenkins-data/ || true; fi
if [ -n "$UUID" ]; then entry="UUID=$UUID /var/lib/jenkins ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2"; else entry="$DEVICE /var/lib/jenkins ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2"; fi
if ! grep -q '\s/var/lib/jenkins\s' /etc/fstab; then echo "$entry" | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab; fi
